definitions.card_arrival: A card already ordered has not arrived or its delivery needs tracking.
definitions.card_delivery_estimate: Ask how long card delivery normally takes or for an estimated delivery time.
definitions.card_not_working: General card malfunction without a more specific supported payment status.
definitions.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment is not recognized by the customer.
definitions.lost_or_stolen_card: A physical card is lost or stolen.
definitions.pin_blocked: The card PIN is blocked, including after too many incorrect attempts.
